question: Mahindra and Mahindra collaborated with_____ to explore deployment of its electric vehicles in 2019.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uber.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Mahindra had announced its collaboration with Uber.
 
• This collaboration is to explore the deployment of electric vehicles (EVs) on its platform in several cities.
 
• It announced the deployment of **50 **of its **Electric Vehicles **(EVs) to Uber.
 
• Mahindra worked with public and private players who had initially set up over **30 common-use charging points **across multiple locations here.
 
• The collaboration with Uber is aimed at accelerating the large-scale adoption of electric vehicles on shared mobility platforms.
 
• Through this tie-up, driver partners on the Uber app can avail themselves of a package that would include Mahindra electric vehicles.
 
• The package would be priced competitively with attractive financing and insurance premiums from Mahindra and its associates.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Mahindra & Mahindra Limited (M&M) is an Indian multinational automotive manufacturing corporation headquartered in Mumbai.
 
• It was established in** 1945** as Mahindra & Muhammad and later renamed as Mahindra & Mahindra.
 
• M&M is one of the largest vehicle manufacturers by production in India.
 
• It was ranked** 17th** on a list of top companies in India by** Fortune India 500 **in 2018.
